name: List All General Ledger Accounts
description: Returns all General Ledger (GL) accounts that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter GL accounts updated at or after this date-time

queryFilters.name: filters[IsCorporateAccount]
queryFilters.description: Filter by whether the GL account is a corporate or non-corporate (standard) GL account

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the GL account

responseFields.name: data[].IsCorporateAccount
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the GL account is a corporate or non-corporate (standard) GL account

responseFields.name: data[].AccountName
responseFields.description: User provided name of the GL account

responseFields.name: data[].AccountType
responseFields.description: The account type or category of the GL account

responseFields.name: data[].FundAccount
responseFields.description: The type of fund account. Options: Reserve (funds set aside for specific future purposes), Operating (funds set aside for regular operating expenses)

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the GL account's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: User provided name of the GL account

responseFields.name: data[].Type
responseFields.description: The account type or category of the GL account

responseFields.name: data[].OffsetAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the offset account

responseFields.name: data[].ParentGlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the parent general ledger account. If present, it indicates the parent account to which the sub-account belongs.

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyIds
responseFields.description: Unique identifier(s) of the properties associated with the GL account. Note: This endpoint returns hidden properties. To associate hidden properties yielded from this endpoint with those from the Properties endpoint, ensure the IncludeHidden filter is enabled.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
